app.name: LabelLens
app.tagline: Every word on the label, checked for everyone you feed.
lang.label: Language
common.retryIn: You can try again in {seconds} s.
landing.hero.subtitle: Point your phone at a packet. LabelLens reads the small print, checks it against each family member's allergies, diets and limits, and shows you the exact words behind every flag.
landing.hero.posterAlt: A chocolate bar label. Highlighted: Peanuts (22%), Total Sugars 38.0 g, a smudged sodium value, and Natural Flavours.
landing.hero.chipsLabel: What LabelLens found on the sample label
landing.cta.title: See it on a real label.
landing.cta.body: No camera needed. The demo opens a chocolate bar checked for a family of three — tap any flag to see the words behind it.
landing.problem.title: The label is complete. It just isn't readable.
landing.problem.hidden.title: Hidden names
landing.problem.hidden.body: Milk hides as whey or casein. Sugar as invert syrup or maltodextrin. Animal products behind codes like INS 120.
landing.problem.unseen.title: Not seen isn't the same as not there
landing.problem.unseen.body: A blurry photo or a list cut off at the fold means we don't know. Most scanners quietly treat that as absent. We say so.
landing.problem.family.title: One shopper, many eaters
landing.problem.family.body: A child's peanut allergy, a parent's sugar limit, a Jain diet — checked in your head, three times, in a busy aisle.
landing.how.title: From photo to proof in about six seconds.
landing.how.capture.title: Capture
landing.how.capture.body: Live hints for blur, glare and light. It captures on its own once the text is sharp.
landing.how.read.title: Read
landing.how.read.body: Text recognition finds every word and exactly where it sits on the photo.
landing.how.understand.title: Understand
landing.how.understand.body: AI structures ingredients, allergen statements and nutrition — citing the words it used.
landing.how.verify.title: Double-check
landing.how.verify.body: Unclear parts and numbers that don't add up are re-read before anything is decided.
landing.how.decide.title: Decide
landing.how.decide.body: A tested rules engine — not the AI — checks every family member and points to the evidence.
landing.honesty.title: Four honest answers. No guesses.
landing.honesty.body: We tell you what the label says, what it doesn't say, and what we couldn't read.
landing.honesty.conflict.example: “Peanuts (22%)” is in the ingredients, and Aarav is allergic.
landing.honesty.possible.example: “Natural Flavours” doesn't say whether onion or garlic is inside.
landing.honesty.not_listed.example: Sesame appears nowhere in the full, readable ingredient list.
landing.honesty.unknown.example: The sodium value is smudged, so Thatha's limit can't be checked.
landing.honesty.unknownKinds: Unknown comes in two kinds: Not detected — part of the list was unreadable — and Can't determine — the information isn't on the label.
landing.family.title: One packet. A clear answer for each person.
landing.family.body: Add family members once — with a form, a sentence or your voice. Every scan checks all of them together, in English, हिन्दी or తెలుగు.
landing.footer.disclaimer: LabelLens reads labels; it does not give medical advice. When in doubt, check the pack and ask your doctor.
landing.footer.privacy: Photos are processed in memory. Family profiles stay on this device.
result.title: Label check
result.empty.title: No label checked yet
result.empty.body: Scan a packet, or open the demo label to see how a result looks.
result.error.title: We couldn't check this label
result.noProfiles.title: Nobody to check against yet
result.noProfiles.body: This shows what the label says. Add family members to get a verdict for each person.
result.evidence.label: Found on the label
result.unknowns.title: What we couldn't read
result.unknowns.empty: Everything relevant on these photos was readable.
result.summary.label: Summary
scan.title: Photograph the label
scan.subtitle: Add up to 3 photos — the back, plus the side if the ingredients wrap around.
scan.tip: Use a sharp, well-lit photo where the text fills most of the frame.
scan.noProfiles: No family members yet — we'll show what the label says. Add family members to get a verdict for each person.
profiles.title: Family
profiles.subtitle: The people you shop for. Profiles stay on this device — no account needed.
profiles.empty.title: No family members yet
profiles.empty.body: Add the people you shop for, and every scan will check the label for each of them.
about.title: How LabelLens works
about.intro: LabelLens reads a packaged-food label, structures what it says, and checks it against every family member's profile — showing the exact words behind every flag.
about.pipeline.title: The pipeline
about.states.title: The four answers
about.never.title: What we never claim
about.never.body: We never call a product suitable for everyone, risk-free or good for you. We report what the label says, what it doesn't say, and what we couldn't read. Verdicts come from a tested rules engine; AI can only ever raise a result to “Check this”.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy.body: Photos are processed in memory and not stored. Only the extracted label text is cached on our server, keyed by the image, to save quota. Family profiles live in your browser.
about.limits.title: Limitations
about.limits.body: Curved, glossy or crumpled packs can be hard to read, and labels sometimes leave things out. LabelLens is not a medical tool — ask a doctor or dietitian about medical needs.
about.metrics.title: Measured accuracy
about.metrics.pending: Measured results coming soon. We're testing LabelLens on real packets with hand-checked answers.
about.metrics.error: The accuracy results couldn't be loaded.
notFound.title: This page isn't on the label
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.
errors.BAD_IMAGE: We couldn't use this photo. Try a sharper, well-lit shot of the label.
errors.TOO_MANY_IMAGES: Up to 3 photos per scan. Remove one and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: The reading service is busy right now.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The AI reader is unavailable at the moment. Please try again shortly.
errors.VALIDATION: Something in the request wasn't accepted. Check your photos and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach LabelLens. Check your connection and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: This is taking longer than expected. Please try again.
verdict.conflict.threshold: {nutrient} is {value} {unit} per {basis}, above your limit of {limit} {unit}.
verdict.possible.may_contain: The label warns it may contain {item}.
verdict.possible.facility: Made in a facility that also handles {item}.
verdict.possible.ambiguous_source: {term} can come from {category} sources; the label does not say which.
verdict.possible.llm_interpretation: {term} was interpreted by AI as {category}. Please verify on the pack.
verdict.not_listed.complete: Not listed anywhere in the full ingredient list.
verdict.not_listed.within_limit: {nutrient} is {value} {unit} per {basis}, within your limit of {limit} {unit}.
verdict.not_listed.trace_note: Not listed as an ingredient, but the label mentions possible traces of {item}.
verdict.not_listed.veg_mark: Carries the green vegetarian mark and no non-vegetarian ingredients are listed.
verdict.unknown.truncated: Part of the ingredient list is cut off. No {category} found in the readable part.
verdict.unknown.unreadable: Some ingredients are unreadable. No {category} found in the readable part.
verdict.unknown.section_missing: No ingredient list was found in these photos.
verdict.unknown.nutrient_missing: {nutrient} is not readable on this label.
verdict.unknown.nutrition_missing: No nutrition table was found in these photos.
verdict.unknown.not_on_labels: Packaged-food labels do not usually show this, so it cannot be determined.
verdict.unknown.suspect_value: {nutrient} may have been misread, so it is not used for this check.
overall.not_listed: No conflicts on the readable label
nutrition.consistency.mismatch: Calories don't match the listed nutrients ({deviation}% off). A value may be misread.
nutrition.consistency.insufficient: Not enough nutrition values to cross-check.
nutrition.serving_small: This pack holds {servings} servings. Values per pack are much higher than per serving.
unknown.retake_region: Take a closer photo of this area.
unknown.ingredients_truncated: The ingredient list continues beyond the photo.
unknown.unreadable_span: Part of the text is unreadable (blur, glare or a fold).
unknown.veg_mark_unclear: The veg / non-veg mark could not be read clearly.
quality.blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold steady.
quality.glare: There is glare on the label. Tilt the pack slightly.
quality.too_dark: The photo is too dark. Move to better light.
quality.low_resolution: Move closer so the text is larger.
quality.cropped_edge: The text runs off the edge. Include the whole panel.
